title: A conversation thread can hang off any item: a Plan, to-do, calendar entry, event, deal or contact

source.ref: Hub plan 2026-11-24 (project thread: Design a central project and messaging hub; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/BqySUVMoZYsPcR49SBRUqB)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-24: space_plan_comments hangs off a Plan, a to-do or a calendar entry only; deals and contacts have a timeline but no team thread, and dispatch_comments and listing_comments are separate comment systems. Fix: generalize to one thread table keyed by subject_type and subject_id; creating, being assigned or being mentioned follows the thread. Retire the parallel comment tables over time.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
